hero.title: Free & open-source software, crafted with care.
hero.subtitle: Gallifree is an independent studio from France building open-source tools — mostly in Rust — for your devices, your network and your everyday tinkering.

open.title: Open source
open.text: Every line of code is public on GitHub. Read it, fork it, improve it.

rust.title: Built in Rust
rust.text: Fast, memory-safe software that stays light on your hardware.

own.title: Yours to run
own.text: Self-hostable and local-first: your data stays on your machines.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: What we are building right now.
projects.exposr: A self-hosted TCP/UDP reverse tunnel with an admin web UI. Expose services behind NAT through your own server.
projects.rustdeck: A Lua-scriptable controller for FIFINE Ampligame D6 and Stream Deck macro pads, with both a GUI and a TUI.
projects.rustart: A Rust/egui Android launcher for the Galaxy Z Flip, covering both screens, with a built-in MCP server.
projects.dicturs: Offline voice commands for your desktop: say a keyword and it runs your shell command. Speech recognition with whisper.cpp, as a CLI, a TUI and a desktop app.
projects.llegion: A fast, native control panel for Ollama: run, monitor, benchmark and secure your local models from a desktop app or a terminal UI.
projects.pimpbox-rgb: Control your OpenRGB lighting from a desktop app or a terminal UI: live device previews, LED painting, zones and profiles.

exposr.tagline: Expose anything behind NAT, from your own server.
exposr.intro: exposr is a self-hosted TCP and UDP reverse tunnel. Run the server on a public machine and the client next to your services, then manage everything from a live web dashboard, with no config files and no restarts.

tcpudp.title: TCP and UDP
tcpudp.text: Game servers, SSH, VPNs, media servers: forward any TCP or UDP port through an encrypted tunnel.

live.title: Live admin dashboard
live.text: Add clients and services from your browser. Changes reach clients instantly, with live traffic and connection stats.

tls.title: TLS with certificate pinning
tls.text: Everything runs over TLS. Clients pin the server's certificate fingerprint, so you don't need a certificate authority.

deploy.title: Easy to deploy
deploy.text: Ships as a Docker Compose stack with MongoDB, ready for Coolify, plus Docker images for the client.

shots.0: exposr dashboard with live traffic, services and recent activity
shots.1: exposr services list with public ports, local addresses and traffic

rustdeck.tagline: Your macro pad, scripted in Lua.
rustdeck.intro: rustdeck drives FIFINE Ampligame D6 and Elgato Stream Deck macro pads on Linux. Lay out pages of buttons in a desktop editor or in your terminal, and give every key a Lua script.

lua.title: Lua on every key
lua.text: Launch apps, send shortcuts, run shell scripts or show live values, with separate actions for a press and a long press.

pages.title: Pages that follow your focus
pages.text: The deck switches pages to match the focused app: browser controls in Chrome, terminal actions in your terminal.

devices.title: Several devices
devices.text: Works with the FIFINE Ampligame D6, Elgato Stream Deck and generic HID keyboard macro pads.

guitui.title: GUI and TUI
guitui.text: Edit your layout in a desktop app built with egui, or straight from the terminal with ratatui.

shots.0: rustdeck editor showing a browser page of buttons for the FIFINE Ampligame D6

rustart.tagline: One launcher for both screens of your Galaxy Z Flip.
rustart.intro: rustart is an Android launcher written in Rust with egui and wgpu, built for the Galaxy Z Flip. It covers the main screen and the cover screen, and its built-in MCP server lets an AI assistant organise your apps.

gpu.title: Rust on the GPU
gpu.text: Rendered with egui on wgpu for a smooth, lightweight home screen, with only a thin Kotlin layer.

screens.title: Both screens
screens.text: Layouts made for the tall main display and for the small cover screen.

mcp.title: Built-in MCP server
mcp.text: A local MCP API lets AI assistants sort your apps, organise your layout and change settings.

search.title: Find apps fast
search.text: A search bar always within reach, and apps grouped using the categories Android provides.

shots.0: rustart home screen with an app grid and a search bar
